reviews.comment:
La atención de los empleados Excelente. Lo único malo es que no pude cargar combustible porque desde hacía 3 semanas que estaban sin sistema visa débito. deberían solucionar esto, hoy en día mucha gente usa débito , pasaron 3 semanas y no sabían cuando lo iban a reparar. Por suerte pude cargar en la YPF de monte quemado. A 50 km de Taco Pozo

(Translated by Google)
The staff's service was excellent. The only downside was that I couldn't get fuel because their Visa debit system had been down for three weeks. They really need to fix this; nowadays, many people use debit cards, and three weeks passed with no word on when it would be repaired. Luckily, I was able to fill up at the YPF station in Monte Quemado, 50 km from Taco Pozo.
